cases.label: REFUSE: outside-project path in a real corpus
cases.text: bb_index : refusing a path outside the project. "/etc/hostname" resolves to /etc/hostname, which is not inside /home/ishaq2321/bb_tests/repositories/graphql-js. bb_index indexes THIS project's files; an out-of-tree path would be stored with a "project-relative" path that is not relative to anything, and every scoped query, file name and freshness check in the index would then be wrong for it.

bbIndex.pathDescription: Project-relative file (reindex only that file) or directory (incremental index of changed files); for mode=post, the project root or a directory inside it whose derived phases should be re-run (a file path is refused). REQUIRED in every mode and checked rather than ignored. Must resolve INSIDE the project: both sides are resolved through realpath, so a symlink inside the project pointing out of it is refused too.
